integrity: Full formula, all endpoint limits, and strict order are derived analytically; an independently implemented conditional-quadrature check is provided. Independent mathematical validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform whole-sphere apex with a fixed geodesic edge of length strictly between zero and pi. The endpoint families are weak limits, not fixed-base formulae at degenerate bases. Historical priority is provisional because a related 2017 full text was not obtained. The numerical checker corroborates, rather than replaces, the geometric proof.
title: Exact Lexell-area distribution and stochastic ordering for a uniform spherical apex
